description: Enroute chart ICAO - Lower Airspace; Rutna karta ICAO - Donji zračni prostor is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Državna geodetska uprava. ICAO route map - Lower airspace at 1:1 000 000 scale. The map covers the entire territory of the Republic of Croatia (FIR Zagreb) and shows ATS routes including directions, distances, significant points, radio navigational aids with WGS-84 coordinates, frequency and identification, airspace structure with lower and upper boundary, hazardous areas, conditionally prohibited areas and ... Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Enroute chart ICAO - Lower Airspace; ICAO Route Map - Lower Airspace" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include zračni promet, prometne mreže, ICAO, donji zračni prostor, inspiregeoportal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
